flags.headline: ABT -2.36% today, continuing a -7.3% one-month slide; no fresh catalyst today
flags.detail: No news specific to today's move. Cumulative pressure reflects (a) a $384.999M DOJ False Claims Act settlement over infant-formula manufacturing/testing at Sturgis, MI and Casa Grande, AZ (announced 2026-09-14, so 11 days old, not new), and (b) continuing digestion of slower Nutrition-segment recovery and device competition. Nothing new today; flagged as context, not escalated.
